build_MLP: build a multi-layer perceptron with configurable input hidden output dims and activation function
build_DropPath: build a DropPath regularization module that randomly drops paths during training with configurable probability
build_LayerNorm2d: build a 2D layer normalization module for normalizing feature maps across spatial dimensions
run_select_closest_cond_frames: select temporally closest conditioning frames from a dictionary of frame outputs for video segmentation
run_get_1d_sine_pe: generate 1D sine positional embeddings for transformer models given position indices and embedding dimension
